ID.description: A name for a node or edge, so an edge can refer to it. Defaults to n1, n2, … for nodes and e1, e2, … for edges.

TEXT.description: What a node shows. $…$ spans render as math, and a text that is just an image URL renders as the image. On a blank it is the answer, hidden until the learner fills it.

SHAPE.description: A node's outline: rounded, rect, pill, circle. Defaults to rounded.

COLOR.description: A node's colour: gray, red, orange, amber, yellow, green, teal, blue, indigo, purple, pink. Defaults to a neutral fill.

SIZE.description: A node's size: small, medium, large. The hub defaults to large, other nodes to medium.

FROM.description: Where an edge starts: a node's id, or its exact text. The hub is "hub" or its text.

TO.description: Where an edge ends: a node's id, or its exact text.

LABEL.description: The words on an edge, naming the relationship. On a blank edge it is the answer, hidden until the learner fills it.

STYLE.description: How an edge is drawn: solid, dashed, solid-arrow, dashed-arrow. Defaults to solid.

ASSESS.description: Scores a node or edge: assess [expected] makes it a blank whose answer is its own text or label; assess [distractor points -1] makes it a wrong answer that sits only in the tray.

TITLE.description: The heading shown above the web.

THEME.description: The colour scheme, DARK or LIGHT, written as a bare tag. Defaults to LIGHT.

INSTANT_FEEDBACK.description: true colours each blank right or wrong as the learner fills it. Defaults to false: feedback waits until the learner checks.

TRAY_ALIGN.description: Where a tray sits beside the web, written as a bare tag: right, left, top, bottom. The node tray defaults to right, the label tray to bottom.

HUB.description: The node at the centre of the web, e.g. hub text "The Cell" {}. Every other node sits on a circle around it. Its id is always `hub`.

NODE.description: One node around the hub, described by a chain ending in {}, e.g. node text "Nucleus" {}.

EDGE.description: One line between nodes, described by a chain ending in {}, e.g. edge from "hub" to "Nucleus" label "contains" {}.

EXPECTED.description: Makes a node or edge a blank. Its own text (or label) is the answer, and joins the tray.

DISTRACTOR.description: Makes a node or edge a wrong answer: its text (or label) joins the tray, and it is not drawn in the web.

POINTS.description: What a blank is worth when filled correctly (above 0, default 1), or what a distractor costs when dropped on a blank (0 or below, default 0).
